name: Mexico
hook: A country asked through its emperors, revolutions, muralists and border.

facts.label: independence from Spain
facts.statement: Mexico won independence from Spain in 1821, after a war that began with the Grito de Dolores in 1810.

facts.label: Maximilian
facts.statement: Napoleon III installed Austrian Archduke Maximilian as emperor of Mexico in 1864; he landed at Veracruz and lived at Chapultepec Castle.

facts.label: Santa Anna
facts.statement: Antonio Lopez de Santa Anna was Mexico's on-again, off-again president; he stormed the Alamo in 1836 and lost a leg in the Pastry War.

facts.label: Pancho Villa
facts.statement: Pancho Villa was the Mexican revolutionary and bandit whose gang raided Columbus, New Mexico, in 1916.

facts.label: the Aztecs
facts.statement: The Aztecs gave Mexico the volcano Popocatepetl, whose name means "smoking mountain"; their rain god was Tlaloc.

facts.label: Diego Rivera
facts.statement: Diego Rivera, husband of Frida Kahlo, painted his first major mural at Mexico City's National Preparatory School in the 1920s.

facts.label: Chihuahua
facts.statement: Chihuahua is the border state between Sonora and Coahuila; its capital, state and desert all share the name.
